name: Soot Sprite (Example)
author: voodoo573
description: EXAMPLE ITEM. Mischievous little spirits of chimney smoke that steal shiny things and leave sooty footprints everywhere. More nuisance than menace.
summary: Example CR 1/4 elemental: a mischievous chimney spirit.

traits.name: Smoke Form
traits.desc: Can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Sooty Slap
actions.desc: Melee Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft. Hit: 1d4+3 bludgeoning.

actions.name: Puff of Soot (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: 5-ft. cube within 15 ft., DC 10 Con save or blinded until the end of its next turn.
